# Realtime

Short-lived tickets for the realtime (websocket) event stream the customer app uses. For developers building a live UI on top of opensms.

Back to the [API reference index](README.md). Shared shapes are in [Schemas](schemas.md); conventions (auth headers, errors, pagination, idempotency) are in the [index](README.md#conventions).

| Method | Path | Summary | Live example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | [`/v1/realtime/tickets`](#post-v1realtimetickets) | Issue single-use workspace-scoped WebSocket ticket | error path only |

### POST /v1/realtime/tickets

**Issue single-use workspace-scoped WebSocket ticket**

Operation ID: _none in contract_. Tag: _none in contract_.

Requires customer session, TLS and configured exact Origin. Cookie authentication additionally requires X-CSRF-Token. Ticket expires within 60 seconds and is consumed once by wss realtime upgrade.

**Auth:** Not declared in the contract (the operation has no `security` entry and the spec has no global default). See the description for what the handler requires.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Origin` | header | string (uri) | yes |  |  |
| `X-CSRF-Token` | header | string | no |  |  |

**Request body** (`application/json`, required)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `workspace_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |  |
| `environment` | string | yes |  | One of: `sandbox`, `live`. |

Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | One-use ticket issued | `application/json`: see fields below |
| `400` | Invalid scope | No body |
| `401` | Inactive session or missing membership | No body |
| `403` | Origin or TLS or CSRF rejected | No body |
| `503` | Ticket issuance unavailable | No body |

Response `200` fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ticket` | string | yes |  |  |
| `expires_at` | string (date-time) | yes |  |  |

**Example** (captured live from the local stack)

```bash
curl -s -X POST "$OPENSMS_API/v1/realtime/tickets" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sess__9lZ...' \
  -H 'X-Workspace-ID: 45d5c55a-085e-4cce-83aa-e35ef7bb31c4' \
  -H 'X-Environment: sandbox' \
  -H 'Origin: http://localhost:5190'
```

Response `403` (`application/problem+json`):

```json
{
  "type": "about:blank",
  "title": "Forbidden",
  "status": 403,
  "detail": "ticket requires HTTPS and an allowed Origin"
}
```

Why this is not the success path: Tickets are issued only over HTTPS from an allowed Origin; the docs stack serves plain HTTP, so the request is refused.
